name: Guess Who Said It
shortDescription: A host-led Zoom icebreaker where players submit anonymous prompt answers, then everyone guesses who wrote a revealed response. Fast rounds, live scores, and a final tie-aware leaderboard keep it playful and low-pressure.

generation.notes: Built from approved issue #401 with a distinct anonymous-answer author-guess loop to reduce overlap with existing word-focused icebreakers. Implemented on the shared multiplayer session API with moderator-created room codes and /join/{code} player entry. The issue requested no social sharing UI, so no share drawer trigger was added. Token counts are estimated.

suggestion.prompt:
## App Suggestion

**Category:** Icebreakers
**Requestor:** Jeff Holst

### Description

Multiplayer Zoom icebreaker called "Guess Who Said It". Moderator shares screen; players join from their own devices via a shared link. Flow: moderator join screen → waiting room → answer round → guessing round → round results → final leaderboard. Use fun, safe, office-appropriate prompts. Moderator screen should show join link + copy button, round count selector, persistent player board (name, status, score), round controls, timer, and a hidden reveal-author panel with submitted answers. Player flow: enter name, wait for moderator, answer each prompt, submit, then guess which player wrote a shown answer from a grid of names; disable controls after voting until round ends. Include subtle motion, confetti for winners, gentle comic-deflate for non-winners, and no social sharing UI.
